name: Docmost

lifecycle.note: Official Docker Compose runs the web app with PostgreSQL and Redis; first workspace creation remains a setup step.

cliSetup.note: Use the deterministic Docmost CLI plan/apply, then create the first workspace and prove a page, attachment, and restore.

security: Keep the app, database, Redis, and workspace private; persist a random application secret and database credentials outside catalog or rendered manifests.
pitfalls: APP_SECRET and DATABASE_URL have no documented _FILE form; the v2 recipe uses owner-only generated environment, which remains visible to Docker inspection access. Shared first-owner setup uses the fixed admin@example.test email in this batch.
Bases and Kanban are commercial features, not included in the Community edition.
Back up PostgreSQL and local attachment storage consistently.
